tweet.text:
The “big takeaway” in that writeup is a bit silly. Otherwise the writeup is pretty good. 

For me the big takeaway (if big is the right word) is that TDD and bundling have a positive effect on the structure of the code. That CRAP analysis can be overdone (eg 4). And that the tests produced by mutation are not significantly different to justify the premise that negative tests are superior to intentional positive tests. 

That last was the goal of this experiment.
